create.name: Sri Aurobindo Center of Los Angeles
create.bio:
The Sri Aurobindo Center of Los Angeles, which also runs as the East-West Cultural Center, is a small house and garden in Culver City devoted to the Integral Yoga of Sri Aurobindo and the Mother. It was started in 1953 by Jyotipriya, the name the Mother gave to Judith Tyberg, an American scholar who became their direct disciple, and it has kept relics of Sri Aurobindo in its meditation room since August 1992.

The centre works as a quiet devotional community rather than a school. Members meet over Zoom three evenings a week for collective sadhana, keep the darshan days of Sri Aurobindo and the Mother, gather for work offerings at the house, and hold a retreat twice a year. Visitors may come to meditate in the relics room, and seekers can arrange longer stays to live in its atmosphere. It also has a library, a book and gift shop, a quarterly newsletter called Quest, and online material such as a line-by-line study of Savitri and recordings of mantras chanted by Jyotipriya.

courses.title: Collective sadhana on Zoom (Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays)
courses.description: Hour-long online meetings at 7 pm Pacific time three evenings a week, each with its own theme, in which members read from Sri Aurobindo and the Mother and meditate together. Open to anyone; joining details are on the page.

courses.title: Retreats and extended stays at the Center
courses.description: The Center holds a retreat twice a year and welcomes seekers who want to stay for a longer period, take part in its work offerings and meditate in the room that holds Sri Aurobindo's relics. Arrange visits by email or phone.

free_resources.title: Savitri Study – Line by Line
free_resources.description: A study of Sri Aurobindo's epic poem Savitri set out book by book, from the introduction through all twelve books, for reading at your own pace.

free_resources.title: Mantras by Jyotipriya
free_resources.description: Recordings of mantras chanted by the Center's founder, offered free to listen to or download.
